description: General-purpose control battery v2 for Type-I (false-demolition) calibration. VALID-HEAVY and NEAR-MISS by design: the 24 valid items look superficially suspicious (many summands, pp-vs-relative distinctions, valid-but-unusual logic, correct-but-tricky citations) yet survive the strongest defence; they are what a too-aggressive auditor over-condemns, so they are what actually bounds the Type-I rate. The 12 invalid items each carry exactly one clear, verifiable defect. Every numeric/date label is checked in code (see build). Domain-neutral base layer; a domain battery stacks on top. FDR = P(demolished|valid) = Type-I; TDR = P(demolished|invalid) = power.
